verdict.rationale: Slate lets a developer run checks directly: shell commands via `!` and agent-performed manual integration tests. Its permission system (allow/ask/deny per action) requires approval before actions proceed, which gives a review gate. However, nothing in the evidence shows a diff view or a pre-merge review workflow. Missing for 10: documented diff inspection/review UI, explicit pre-merge check or CI integration, independent hands-on corroboration.
